decisions.rationale: Per $SPLUNK_HOME/etc/system/README/restmap.conf.spec, the `script` key is for handlers NOT derived from BaseRestHandler. Setting it forced Splunk into the legacy runScript.py codepath which does os.chdir(os.path.dirname(script)) — a bare filename dirnames to '' → FileNotFoundError.

decisions.decision: Test 6 expected 'sub-10ms' cache hit, adjusted to accept 'noticeably faster'
decisions.rationale: Splunk REST framework overhead (TLS, auth, routing) imposes a ~100ms floor regardless of cache. 2.4x speedup on identical payload is sufficient evidence the cache is serving.

decisions.decision: build_release.sh now strips macOS xattrs via bsdtar --no-mac-metadata --no-xattrs --no-acls --no-fflags
decisions.rationale: macOS 14+ attaches com.apple.provenance xattr to every file. bsdtar serializes xattrs as PaxHeader entries which Splunk's `splunk install app` archive validator misreads as a second top-level subdirectory, rejecting the archive. GNU tar tolerates these entries but Splunk's validator does not.
